Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring information on preparing children for success in school.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to early learning; adding a new section to chapter28A.300 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that there is anincreasing awareness of the importance of the first five years of lifein a child's development. The legislature further finds that researchhas demonstrated that high quality early childhood education andlearning programs can have significant and lasting benefits for a childduring those early years.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.300RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By August 2003 and annually thereafter, the superintendent ofpublic instruction shall prepare, distribute, and post on the agencyweb site information for parents, preschools, and child care providersabout how to select early childhood education programs for children,how best to prepare children for kindergarten, and guidelines forpreparing children for success in school, including kindergartenreadiness guidelines. In preparing the information, the superintendent p. 1 SB 5546shall consult with individuals with knowledge of early childhoodeducation and learning, including but not limited to early childhoodeducators, nonprofit associations for early childhood education,parents, child care providers, and early childhood education faculty atinstitutions of higher education.
